guitar.guitaristsText: Don Felder / Joe Walsh / Glenn Frey
guitar.modelsText: Gibson EDS-1275, Les Paul, Telecaster, Takamine/Martin acoustics
models: Gibson EDS-1275, Les Paul, Telecaster, Takamine
guitar.notes: Don Felder's Gibson EDS-1275 double-neck (for 'Hotel California') is iconic; the band also used Telecasters and Les Pauls broadly. Medium confidence reflects the multiple players/instruments.

tone.target: chorused clean-to-mild crunch with bright arpeggios
tone.profile: chorused clean-to-mild crunch with bright arpeggios
tone.summary: A bright, chorused signal chain using a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) paired with a 2x12 cabinet to capture the classic Eagles sound, enhanced by Chorus and Digital Delay for arpeggios and sustain.

rig.name: The Eagles - Hotel California - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Smooth out dynamics and enhance the sustain of arpeggios.
Provide a gentle, breakup crunch for the rhythm parts without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen to mimic the light grit of vintage tube amps (Vox/Fender) rather than modern dirt pedals.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more aggressive, but still suitable for mild crunch.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (Not needed for this specific tone).
blocks.gap: The target tone does not require a wah effect.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean, and chimey sound of a Fender-style amplifier.
Provide a bright and articulate sound suitable for clean arpeggios.
blocks.gap: The 2x12 is ideal for the specified Fender/Vox-style tone.

alternatives.reason: Too British and less chimey for this specific song.

blocks.purpose: Add the required slight chorus effect to enhance arpeggios and give a vintage sheen.
Provide the required plate ambience and smooth lead sustain.
blocks.gap: Plate reverb is a good substitute for general vintage room ambiance when specific Room/Spring settings are not ideal.

alternatives.reason: A viable alternative, but Plate often provides better sustain control.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the arpeggiated picking and add depth to the lead lines.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal depth for vintage clean tones.

proposals.reason: Enhance the chimey, open sound required for arpeggios.
